method: Custom vectorized photon Monte Carlo in a 30 cm water cube (SSD 100 cm, 10x10 cm field): Klein-Nishina Compton sampling, coherent scattering via atomic form factors, parameterized photoelectric and pair cross sections. Track length, interactions and energy transfer scored in the 1-cm-radius, 0.2-cm-thick cylinder at 5 cm depth; 4 million photon histories, normalized by Phi0 = primary fluence at 105 cm (110.25 cm^2 - equivalent area). Electron layer from a Spencer-Fano/CSDA equilibrium solution: initial electron spectrum from the photon interactions at the point, coupled Moller delta-ray production, Bethe collision and radiative stopping powers for water (I=78 eV) and air (I=85.7 eV); electron fluence, delta fraction, s_w,air (cutoff 10 keV with track-end term) and PDD computed from the depth-resolved kerma profile with electron build-up convolution.
data_sources: Klein-Nishina cross sections; water mass attenuation/energy-absorption coefficients approximated from NIST XCOM-type values (mu_tot ~0.066 cm^2/g at 1.25 MeV; mu_en/rho ~0.0297); Bethe stopping powers per ICRU-37 (I_water=78 eV, I_air=85.7 eV); Moller knock-on cross section for delta rays; Co-60 PDD benchmark data (10x10, SSD 100) for cross-check (~80% at 5 cm).
